title: AE desk notes — Maya Patel — 2026-03-30
content:
AE scratchpad: quick log + follow-ups (very rough)

Date: 2026-03-30 (Monday)
Focus: re-engage mid-market trial accounts, push two Dedicated deals to demo + procurement, prep for Wed exec sync with Brightlane

Morning blocks:
- 08:30 - 09:00: triage inbox / reply prospect threads / calendar prep
- 09:00 - 11:30: outbound dials / cadence touches (high-volume)
- 11:30 - 12:00: update CRM + quick sync w/ Tom (prep Brightlane notes)
- 13:00 - 16:00: demos + discovery calls (booked)
- 16:00 - 17:30: admin: quotes, pricing, send SOW draft, follow-ups

Daily metrics (target)
- Dials: 75 (actual: --)
- Connects: 12
- Discovery meetings: 3
- Demos: 2
- Meetings set for next week: 4

Hot accounts to prioritize
1) Brightlane Analytics (MRR potential $30k/mo)
   - Contact: Aaron Kim (CTO) / aaron@brightlane.ai (intro call 2026-03-24)
   - Notes: evaluating hosted + dedicated for real-time QA/feedback. Main pain: unpredictable latency spikes during peak queries. Interested in Dedicated for steady throughput + fallback to hosted.
   - Ask: get exec demo Wed 2026-04-01; show canary rollback and region failover. Bring SRE Tom for kernel/latency talk.
   - Next action: send one-pager on failover + SLA by EOD (Tom to review)

2) Halcyon Health (pilot)
   - Contact: Priya Rao (Head of NLP) / priya@halcyon-health.com
   - Notes: POC on private deployment (VPC) for PHI data. Concern: KMS/HSM integration + audit logs. Legal looped in (contract spec).
   - Ask: connect infra lead w/ Eng-private (Sam) for deep dive.
   - Next action: schedule 1-hr infra call (target: next Tue); attach compliance checklist.

3) WidgetCo (SMB, inbound trial)
   - Contact: Ben (Product) via trial signup, +1 415-555-01xx (voicemail)
   - Notes: trial using hosted embeddings; cost spike reported. Show Optimize suggestions (batching + quantization).
   - Next action: 10-min call to review token economics + suggest quantization profile (send sample config).

Call list (prioritized)
- 09:00 Ben / WidgetCo — voicemails x2, leave short note: "saw cost spike, quick config suggestions"
- 09:20 Aaron / Brightlane — prep for Wed exec demo, confirm time and participants
- 09:45 Priya / Halcyon — book infra call, mention KMS options
- 10:15 Tess / ReFork Media — cold follow, interest in multimodal LLMs for search; send case study on Dedicated throughput
- 10:45 Logan / Travellytics — pricing follow-up (reserved capacity)
- 11:15 Demo slot prep: Brightlane slides + live env (have canary ready)

Disposition shorthand (for CRM)
- LEAD: new inbound lead
- MQL: marketing qualified
- SQL: sales qual'd, discovery done
- POC: in pilot / evaluation
- DEAL: committed / legal loop
- NOPE: not a fit / ghosted

Quick objection cheat sheet (short lines to use on calls)
- "Latency spikes?" -> "We provide Dedicated pools + automatic fallback to hosted variants; can show live traces and per-route SLOs."
- "Cost is too high" -> "Recommend Redwood Optimize profile: batching + KV caching can cut per-token cost by 30-50% on steady workloads."
- "Security/compliance" -> "Private deployment supports VPC + KMS/HSM and audit logs; we can run on-prem for air-gapped needs."

Email snippets (copy/paste friendly)
- Follow-up after discovery:
  Subject: Next steps + sandbox access
  Body: Hi {first_name}, great to chat — attaching the sandbox playbook and suggested config for your use-case. Proposed next step: infra deep-dive next week (30–60 mins) to cover network & KMS. Thoughts on Tue/Wed? — Maya

- Post-demo recap (Brightlane):
  Subject: Brightlane demo recap + action items
  Body: Thanks for time today — recap: Dedicated pool for steady latency, canary rollback, region failover, SLOs at token level. Action items: 1) share SLA one-pager (Tom) 2) schedule exec Q&A 3) procurement checklist (legal).

Open todos (quick)
- [ ] Finalize Brightlane demo deck (Tom to review)
- [ ] Draft one-pager on Dedicated vs Hosted fallback (send to Aaron)
- [ ] Attach compliance checklist for Halcyon + request infra availability
- [ ] Send cost-optimization config to WidgetCo (sample quant + batching settings)
- [ ] Update CRM stages for 5 inbound trial leads

CRM notes to paste after calls (short form)
- Brightlane: SQL — interested in Dedicated; procurement target Q2; technical call scheduled 2026-04-01; legal intro needed.
- Halcyon: POC — Private deployment; NDA inbound; compliance docs requested.

Prep checklist for Wed exec demo (Brightlane)
- confirm exec attendees + time
- confirm load profile for live demo (sample queries + distribution)
- run canary fallback test in staging (Tom)
- bring SRE support for kernel/latency questions
- one-pager SLA + pricing ranges ready to show

Notes from Fri quick sync (internal)
- Procurement at Brightlane asked for 12 month committed capacity numbers; show monthly breakouts + burst options.
- Legal needs sample DPA + SOC-type checklist for Halcyon (note: check security-and-compliance drive)
- Engineering requested anonymized logs for demo to avoid PII — prepare sanitized dataset by Tue.

Evening wrap-up (what to do tomorrow)
- follow up on Tom's review of SLA one-pager
- schedule Halcyon infra call
- 30-min practice run w/ demo env at 08:45 before exec demo
- refresh the Optimize pitch deck (quick slide on quantization wins)

Random notes & brain dump (unstructured)
- think about a short "SLA + fallback" one-pager specifically for GTM: helps shorten exec buy-in cycle
- consider building a standard 10-min cost-savings playbook for trials (reduce churn from cost shock)
- ask product for a simple graph: cost per 1k tokens across quant levels (to include in emails)

End of scratchpad — keep terse, update CRM asap after calls.

-- Maya
